theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 41 群

items.colloc: office politics 辦公室政治 | local politics 地方政治
items.distinct: policy 政策 | political 政治的
ex: Office politics can be stressful for new employees.
辦公室政治對新進員工來說可能很有壓力。
She has always been interested in national politics.
她一直對國家政治很感興趣。
Management decided to stay out of company politics.
管理層決定不參與公司的派系鬥爭。

items.colloc: air pollution 空氣污染 | reduce pollution 減少污染
items.distinct: pollutant 污染物 | pollute 污染（動詞）
ex: Strict regulations help to reduce industrial pollution.
嚴格的法規有助於減少工業污染。
The company faces lawsuits over water pollution.
該公司面臨關於水污染的訴訟。
Noise pollution is a major issue in urban areas.
噪音污染是都會區的一大問題。

items.pos: adj. 正面的；確信的；積極的
items.colloc: positive feedback 正面回饋 | positive result 陽性結果
items.distinct: optimistic 樂觀的 | affirmative 肯定的
ex: The client provided very positive feedback on our design.
客戶對我們的設計提供了非常正面的回饋。
We are positive that the deal will close soon.
我們確信這筆交易很快就會成交。
The team maintained a positive attitude during the crisis.
團隊在危機期間保持了積極的態度。

items.colloc: precise measurement 精確測量 | precise information 明確資訊
items.distinct: accurate 準確的 | concise 簡潔的
ex: Please provide the precise date for the delivery.
請提供貨運送達的確切日期。
The machine requires precise calibration before use.
機器在使用前需要精確的校準。
He gave a precise summary of the meeting highlights.
他對會議重點做了精確的摘要。

items.pos: n. 獎品；獎金 | v. 重視
items.colloc: win a prize 贏得獎項 | grand prize 首獎
items.distinct: award 獎項（正式） | reward 獎勵
ex: The company offers a cash prize for the best idea.
公司為最佳點子提供現金獎勵。
We prize honesty above all other employee traits.
我們重視誠實勝過其他員工特質。
She won the top prize in the international competition.
她在國際競賽中贏得了最高獎項。

items.colloc: legal profession 法律界 | enter the profession 進入該行業
items.distinct: occupation 工作 | career 生涯
ex: He has been in the accounting profession for years.
他在會計界工作多年。
The medical profession requires constant learning.
醫療專業需要不斷地學習。
She decided to leave the legal profession last month.
她上個月決定離開法律界。

items.colloc: book publisher 書籍出版商 | major publisher 主要發行商
items.distinct: author 作者 | editor 編輯
ex: The publisher will release the new manual tomorrow.
出版商明天將發行這本新手冊。
She works as a senior editor for a major publisher.
她在一家大出版社擔任資深編輯。
Authors often negotiate contracts with the publisher.
作者常與出版商協商合約。

items.colloc: rare opportunity 難得的機會 | rare disease 罕見疾病
items.distinct: scarce 匱乏的 | unique 獨特的
ex: This is a rare opportunity to expand into Asia.
這是一個拓展亞洲市場的難得機會。
It is rare for him to miss a deadline.
他幾乎從未錯過截止日期。
Finding such experienced staff is quite rare.
找到經驗如此豐富的員工相當罕見。

items.colloc: business relationship 商業關係 | build a relationship 建立關係
items.distinct: connection 連結 | rapport 融洽關係
ex: Maintaining a good relationship with clients is vital.
與客戶保持良好的關係至關重要。
There is a strong relationship between price and quality.
價格與品質之間有強烈的關聯。
We have developed a long-term relationship with them.
我們已經與他們建立了長期的合作關係。

items.colloc: strict ruler 嚴格的統治者 | measure with a ruler 用尺測量
items.distinct: rule 規則 | regulation 規定
ex: Use a ruler to draw a straight line here.
用尺在這裡畫一條直線。
The historical figure was known as a fair ruler.
這位歷史人物以公正的統治者聞名。
Everything must be measured with a precise ruler.
每一項都必須用精確的尺測量。

items.pos: n. 分數；成績 | v. 得分
items.colloc: high score 高分 | score a point 得分
items.distinct: grade 等級 | result 結果
ex: The candidate achieved a high score on the test.
這位候選人在測試中獲得了高分。
Our team managed to score in the final minute.
我們隊伍在最後一分鐘成功得分。
She is reviewing the scores from the survey.
她正在檢視調查問卷的得分。

items.pos: v. 刮傷；抓 | n. 刮痕
items.colloc: scratch the surface 觸及皮毛 | leave a scratch 留下刮痕
items.distinct: scrape 擦傷 | scribble 潦草書寫
ex: Please be careful not to scratch the new desk.
請小心不要刮傷新的辦公桌。
The delivery box had a deep scratch on it.
快遞箱上有一個深深的刮痕。
He started the business from scratch last year.
他去年白手起家創立了這間公司。

items.pos: adj. 資深的；年長的 | n. 上級；年長者
items.colloc: senior manager 資深經理 | senior staff 資深員工
items.distinct: superior 上司 | junior 資淺的
ex: The proposal requires approval from a senior manager.
該提案需要資深經理的批准。
She is a senior member of the research department.
她是研究部門的資深成員。
He sought advice from his senior regarding the project.
他針對該專案向他的上級尋求建議。

items.pos: adj. 銳利的；明顯的；急劇的
items.colloc: sharp increase 急劇增加 | sharp drop 銳減
items.distinct: keen 敏銳的 | pointed 尖銳的
ex: We noticed a sharp increase in sales this quarter.
我們注意到本季銷售額有急劇增加。
The company reported a sharp decline in profit.
公司回報獲利大幅下滑。
His sharp eyes caught the error in the report.
他敏銳的眼睛察覺了報告中的錯誤。

items.colloc: rise sharply 急劇上升 | criticize sharply 嚴厲批評
items.distinct: suddenly 突然地 | quickly 快速地
ex: Stock prices fell sharply after the announcement.
公告發布後，股價急劇下跌。
Energy costs have risen sharply over the year.
能源成本在過去一年中急劇上升。
The manager spoke sharply to the team members.
經理嚴厲地對團隊成員訓話。

items.colloc: data sheet 數據表 | cover sheet 封面
items.distinct: page 頁 | document 文件
ex: Please print the report on a single sheet.
請將報告印在單張紙上。
Fill out the information sheet before entering.
進入前請填寫資訊表。
Attach a cover sheet to your project proposal.
在你的專案提案上附上一張封面。

items.pos: n. 商店 | v. 購物
items.colloc: online shop 線上商店 | shop around 到處比價
items.distinct: store 大型商店 | boutique 精品店
ex: The local shop sells high-quality office supplies.
這家在地商店販售高品質的辦公用品。
Many people prefer to shop online these days.
現在很多人傾向於線上購物。
It is wise to shop around before buying equipment.
購買設備前先貨比三家是明智的。

items.colloc: shortly after 不久之後 | shortly before 不久之前
items.distinct: soon 即將 | recently 最近
ex: The meeting will start shortly in room B.
會議不久將在 B 室開始。
He arrived shortly after the presentation finished.
簡報結束後不久他就抵達了。
We will be boarding shortly at gate ten.
我們不久後將在十號登機門登機。

items.pos: n. 淋浴；陣雨 | v. 淋浴
items.colloc: take a shower 洗澡 | rain shower 陣雨
items.distinct: bath 盆浴 | storm 風暴
ex: The hotel room has a very modern shower.
飯店房間有非常現代化的淋浴設備。
There was a heavy rain shower this morning.
今天早上有一場大陣雨。
I usually take a shower before going to work.
我習慣在上班前淋浴。

items.colloc: difficult situation 困難處境 | current situation 當前情況
items.distinct: condition 條件/狀況 | circumstance 環境/境遇
ex: We need to assess the current situation carefully.
我們需要仔細評估當前的情況。
The manager handled the difficult situation well.
經理處理這項困難處境處理得很好。
Explain the situation to the client immediately.
請立刻向客戶說明當前狀況。
